description: Least recently used: when the cache is full, evict the entry that was read or written longest ago.
Removing an entry to respect the cache bound. An `onEvict` hook releases resources the entry owns.
Moving an entry to the most-recent end on access. With a `Map`: `delete(key)` then `set(key, value)`.
The caller checks the cache, loads from the source on a miss and stores the result.
Share of lookups answered by the cache. Too small a `max` keeps evicting entries that are about to be used.
Time to live: entries expire after a duration. Usually combined with LRU so stale data does not survive just because it is popular.
